title: Get a valid finite number from the input
goal: Exclude blank spaces before Number conversion, and then use Number.isFinite to determine the result.
summary: length records accept positive, negative and decimal numbers. Blank spaces, non-numeric text, and Infinity should all prompt for refilling.
tasks: completes readAmount(text) and converts a non-empty string of valid digits into a numerical value.
Returns null for an empty string, pure white space, invalid number, or non-finite number. The number 0 is valid.

example.note: Number('') returns 0. You need to use trim() first to determine whether the input is blank.

hint: Do not use if (!number) to judge failure, otherwise the number 0 will also be rejected.
